ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, footer background, filled dark buttons. The near-black that carries all body and display copy

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Button text on light surfaces, pure-black background blocks. Used where maximum contrast is required

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, button borders on light fills. The dominant surface color across all sections

ash-grey.$description: Ash Grey — Hairline borders, disabled dividers, and the dominant link color at 80 occurrences. The neutral that defines edge separation without shadow

mist.$description: Mist — List and grouped-background fills — the recessed surface beneath cards, tables, and secondary containers

slate.$description: Slate — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary body text, inline badge copy, and minor muted surfaces between true ink and slate

cobalt-wash.$description: Cobalt Wash — Promotional bar gradient start. The single chromatic accent in the entire system — only ever appears as part of the blue gradient on top-of-page offer strips

aeonik-pro.$description: Marketing display and heading face. Weight 500 across the entire scale — never heavier. Used for hero headlines ('Banking & Beyond' at 88px), section headings, and emphasis paragraphs. The signature choice is that no heading goes bolder than 500: authority comes from size and tracking, not weight.

inter.$description: Product UI and body face. Carries all buttons, form labels, navigation, badges, and the 16px default body copy. Uppercase 12px labels open to +0.0150em — the only positive tracking in the system, reserved for micro-tags and button labels to add breathing room at small sizes.
